name: Throughput-limited language-model training under a fixed wall-clock budget
objective: Under a fixed 300s charged-training-seconds budget the metric is bought with optimizer steps, so the campaign's live question is where wall clock is lost and which mechanisms return it without changing the arithmetic. The nsys profile of the v2c baseline puts ~43% of wall in GPU gaps and ~26.7% of kernel time in memory-bound norm and elementwise work, so this agenda reads the literature that bears on those two mediators, plus the token-law exchange rate that prices any recovered time in val_bpb.

constraints: fixed training-seconds budget, so a change is worthwhile only if quality lost per step is smaller than quality the extra steps buy
single H200 on a shared 20-tenant host; contention is the dominant noise source
measure num_steps, mfu_percent and total_tokens_M as diagnostics beside every val_bpb
